shir.rule: On family trips, always include at least one straightforward restaurant option. Nature is fine; do not make every day a hike.

recommendationRules.count: 2-4 strong choices plus one clear pick
recommendationRules.areaFromQuery: When the question names an area, search that area first. One well-chosen place there beats a better cuisine match farther out. Do not store the area.
recommendationRules.coffeeRoast: Prefers darker than the current light-roast trend. Sweet Spot is a true coffee place but exclusively light roast. Before sending him back, check sweetspotkaffee.de/kaffee for the weekly lots. In the cafe they pour two espressos only; ask for the nutty/chocolate (usually South/Central America) guest, not the floral filter. Do not expect a dark roast there unless that page stops saying exclusively light.

log.note: Preferred Preysinggarten (Spanish-Mediterranean house, character, very good) over a cuisine-tagged shortlist. A bit less casual than usual was fine because the cooking was.
log.tasteChange: When the question names an area, pick the best well-chosen place inside it. Do not over-weight cuisine tags. Do not store the area.
